	add = {

		value = this.estate_building_stackable_level_building_level_rgo_max
	}
}

REPLACE:fulani_cattle_rearing_pen_max_level = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE"
		value = 3
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.fulani_cattle_rearing_pen_max_level_building_level_development
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location_rank = location_rank:city
		}
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_IS_CITY"
			value = -2
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
		}
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_IS_MEGAPOLIS"
			value = -2
		}
	}

}

REPLACE:market_max_level = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE"
		value = 1
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_DEVELOPMENT"
		value = this.market_max_level_building_level_development
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION"
		value = this.market_max_level_building_level_population
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:city
		}
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_IS_CITY"
			value = 5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis
		}
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_IS_MEGAPOLIS"
			value = 10
		}
	}
	
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner ?= { modifier:market_building_levels != 0 }
		}
		multiply = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FROM_OWNER_MODIFIERS"
			value = this.market_max_level_building_level_from_owner_modifiers
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			modifier:local_market_upgrade_building_levels > 0
		}
		add = {
			desc = "town_rights_marketplace"
			value = modifier:local_market_upgrade_building_levels
		}
	}
}

# Tooltip helpers of market_max_level (cap_tooltips.py): each is one row of the cap, read through this.
market_max_level_building_level_development = {
	value = development
	multiply = 0.1
}

market_max_level_building_level_population = {
	value = population
	multiply = 0.05
}

market_max_level_building_level_from_owner_modifiers = {
	value = 1
	add = owner.modifier:market_building_levels
}
